<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-core`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/field.md`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via InlineGridColumnSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/field.md`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **251** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a10987ae8fa35f1d1e21b756b3ddd907d07a5897` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `830a6c719694d94edcd515ec53c4be585c4df18b` — the merge of head `6185caed0a71444284bb83c545efd82366896b6c` into base `a10987ae8fa35f1d1e21b756b3ddd907d07a5897`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 830a6c719694d94edcd515ec53c4be585c4df18b && git checkout 830a6c719694d94edcd515ec53c4be585c4df18b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a10987ae8fa35f1d1e21b756b3ddd907d07a5897 6185caed0a71444284bb83c545efd82366896b6c && git checkout -B drift-repro a10987ae8fa35f1d1e21b756b3ddd907d07a5897 && git merge --no-ff 6185caed0a71444284bb83c545efd82366896b6c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a10987ae8fa35f1d1e21b756b3ddd907d07a5897
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a10987ae8fa35f1d1e21b756b3ddd907d07a5897` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jS7jCv5PH4ytECQWqf

L1 REWORK · head `f73a4351f074c020dff6c9577c26bbb46cb0bc96` · 2026-11-22T18:12Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:表单里主从明细表的五类格子改了。人员格子可以搜索选人,多选格子可以选多个,标签格子可以加标签,勾选格子是复选框,评分格子是星星。以前这些都是普通文本框:人员要手填用户编号,多选只能填一个值。
- 为什么做:卡 #36043(主从明细表的单元格编辑)。
- 出错会怎样:已有表单的明细表会直接变样(布尔字段从「是 / 否」下拉变成复选框,评分从数字框变成星星)。作者在列上写了 `type` 的不受影响。最坏是这几类格子不好用,已存的数据不受影响。可以整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:REWORK,只有 1 项,只改声明行:`Metadata-protocol` 应为 `semantic`。代码、测试、spec 和文档我读下来都是对的,见下面。

## 要改的(1 项)

1. **`Metadata-protocol: added` 应为 `semantic`。** AGENTS.md 的定义是:新键、新可接受值、新元数据类型是 `added`;含义或默认值变了是 `semantic`;同时有几种时「narrowed over semantic over added」。本 PR 两种都有:
   - `added`:`InlineGridColumnSchema.type` 多了五个值,列多了一个 `max` 键;
   - `semantic`:没写 `type` 的列,`type` 是从子字段推出来的默认值,这个默认值变了。`boolean` / `toggle` 原来推成 `select`,现在是 `boolean`,写入的值也从字符串 `'true'` / `'false'` 变成布尔值;`rating` 从 `number` 变成 `rating`;`user`、`multiselect` / `checkboxes`、`tags` 从 `text` 变成各自的类型。这正是 `spec/src/data/inline-grid-columns.ts` 的 `cellTypeOf` 和 `deriveMasterDetail.ts` 的 `fieldTypeToColumnType` 改的地方。changeset 自己也写了「Visible change on existing forms: a column the table derives from a child field (no `type` written) now follows that field」,也就是作者什么都没改,已有元数据的效果变了。

   所以按「semantic over added」,正文和 changeset 两处都改成 `Metadata-protocol: semantic`。changeset 的级别已经是 minor,不用改。先例:#36478 改 `mobileMaxVisible` 不写时的效果,声明的就是 `semantic`。

## 席位核对

- **卡片关系**:首行 `Fixes #36043`。卡上第 1 项(五类列类型和与主列表相同的格内编辑)和第 3 项(每类都有测试)都做了。第 2 项(在第 1 项之前先把这几列设成只读的过渡做法),正文写明席位认为第 1 项交付后就不需要了,我认。卡的验收(人员可搜索选人、多选能存多个、勾选和评分和主列表一样)都由下面的测试覆盖。`Fixes` 成立。
- **spec**:五个新值都沿用「列类型和同名字段类型同名」的既有规则(people = `user`、check = `boolean` 等),正文写明了。`max` 是 `int().positive()` 的可选键,默认 5。`options`、`multiple` 的 describe 补上了新格子怎么读它们。`cellTypeOf` 里新加的五个类型保留了原来字段类型的填充优先级(`boolean` 同 `select` 为 0,`rating` 同 `number` 为 1,其余三个同 `text` 为 4),所以默认显示哪些推导列不变,原来的预算用例没改照样绿。
- **代码**:
  - 新格子复用主列表的格内控件(`MultiSelectField` / `TagsField` / `UserField` / `RatingField` 的 `inCell`),外面包一层新的 `GridPanelCell`:点外面或 Tab 写入,Esc 不写;
  - 勾选格是 `Checkbox`,`onCheckedChange` 写 `checked === true`;
  - 评分格:数字键设星数,0 清空,超过 `max` 的数字不动;
  - 必填的空列表读作无效。
- **写入从字符串变布尔**:我核过服务端,`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts:1217` 把 `'1'` / `'true'` 强制成 `true`,所以 changeset 说的「the server reads both the same」成立。
- **声明**:`Clause-②: yes (widening)` 对:枚举加值、列加 `max`,`@object-ui/fields` 的 `GridColumn` 跟着放宽,没有删改。`Metadata-protocol` 见第 1 项。`Skills-docs: none — …`:正文说 `git grep skills/` 只有 `objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` 顺带提了一下,没有列类型,属实。不是 `!`,也没有 `(narrowing)`,不欠 dogfood。
- **changeset**:五个包都有条目;spec、fields、plugin-form 是 minor,metadata-core、types 是 patch。逐句核过:五个类型、`max`、各格子的行为、只读面、对已有表单的可见变化、FLS 清洗把 `max` 归为保留,都和 diff 一致。
- **偏差**:清单外的四个文件都是这次放宽的直接后果,正文逐个写了:`INLINE_COLUMN_POSITIONS` 收 `max`;被拒列类型的那条用例从 `boolean` 换成仍被拒的 `toggle`;`form.ts` 的 docblock 不再写「nine」;`field-types.mdx` 列出 14 种格子。我认。
- **已发布文档**:`field-types.mdx` 手写的部分和生成的参考页都和代码一致。合入 main 后的生成文件(`field.md` 计数 109 / 1 / 6 / 116、`authorable-surface/data.json`、四个参考页)都是用生成器重新生成的,没有手改,并且带上了 #36449 的 `showOnCreate` 和 #36399 的 `fieldHistory`。
- **测试**:`GridField.test.tsx` 新的 describe 覆盖五类格子,包括 Esc 不写、Tab 写入、`max: 10` 画十颗星、Clear 写入并关闭。`deriveMasterDetail` 的五个映射都有相邻类型作对照,另有推导和 hydrate 两条路径上的附加项,以及「写了 `type` 的列不变(含布尔字段上的 `type: 'select'`)」。原来三个用例文件改的地方都是布尔列从 select 变成复选框的直接结果。
- **不阻塞**:点外面写入走的是弹层自己的 `onOpenChange`,正文写明在 jsdom 里测不到,浏览器里也没测(NOT MEASURED),用例都用 Tab 离开。这是多选、标签、人员三类格子最常用的写入路径,落地前或落地后在控制台里点一次会更稳。
- **门禁**:本 head 上推导出的 118 族全部跑过,每个都 exit 0;`check:generated`、`check:liveness` 是最新的。PR-body guards 有一次运行被取消,同名的新运行在 17:38:52Z 是 success。
- **CI @ `f73a4351`**:62 success、11 skipped、0 failed(那一条 cancelled 见上);mergeable clean。
- **落地**:席位在并行跑契约档 L2。两份评审都通过后,由区 ready + auto-merge。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f73a4351f074c020dff6c9577c26bbb46cb0bc96`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/inline-grid-columns.ts + ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/grid-field/GridFieldWidget.tsx, ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/gridCellPanels.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts, packages/spec/liveness/field.json, packages/spec/src/inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts

Inputs read: card #36043 (body, triage 7061460926, claim 7076078435; no ruling on the card), the PR body, the 24-file list, the net diff against `main`, and the check-runs on this head. The rest of the diff (tests, generated reference pages, the changeset text, `ui/packages/types`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

Check-runs on the head: 62 success, 11 skipped, 1 cancelled. The cancelled run is `PR-body guards` 137294400704 (started 17:37:52Z). The same check ran again on the same head as 137294492840 (started 17:38:12Z) and succeeded, so the cancelled run is superseded. `Spec property liveness`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Test Core` (all 10 shards), `Test UI` (all 16 shards), `Check Changeset` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are green.

### ① Derived judgments

- `InlineGridColumnSchema.type` goes from nine to fourteen members: `user`, `multiselect`, `tags`, `boolean`, `rating` join. Right. The card asks for exactly these five, and each is spelled as its namesake field type, which is the rule the carriers probe and the ledger row already rely on.
- One new optional key, `max` (positive integer). Right. A typed column carries no field body, so a rating field with `max: 10` would otherwise draw five stars. It is inert on every other cell type, as `accept` is off a file cell.
- No type-conditional rule is added, so `HYDRATED_INLINE_COLUMN_TYPE` in `stack.zod.ts` correctly stays at its one `currency` row. No existing rule refuses `options` on `multiselect`, `multiple` on `user` or `max` on `rating`.
- All four carriers (a relationship field's `inlineColumns`, a form view's `subforms[].columns`, `object-master-detail-form` details, `record:line_items`) take the same schema object and draw through the same grid, so the widening reaches them together. Right.
- Every admitted type has a reader and an editor in `GridFieldWidget.tsx`: `user` hosts `UserField inCell` and reads through `UserField readonly`; `multiselect` hosts `MultiSelectField inCell` and reads option labels; `tags` hosts `TagsField inCell` and reads the joined list; `boolean` is the `Checkbox` primitive and reads the option word; `rating` is `RatingField inCell` and reads as stars. No type is admitted that the grid cannot draw or save.
- Saved value shapes, read against the field schema and `record-validator.ts`: a single person saves the `sys_user` id and several people save an array of ids (`LookupField` writes `option.value`); `multiselect` and `tags` save `string[]`; `boolean` saves `true` / `false`, and the validator's `BOOLEAN_READINGS` still reads the old `'true'` / `'false'` strings the same; `rating` saves an integer from 1 to the column's `max`, or `null` for 0, and the server's `min` / `max` gate on the field stays the authority. `FieldSchema.multiple` names `user` among the multi-capable types. Right.
- Read permission on a people cell: names come from the existing `LookupField` hydration, a `find` / `findOne` on `sys_user` through the session's own data source, and `recordToOption` builds the label from `withoutDeniedFields`. A reader denied the name gets the id or an empty value, never a name. No new server path. Right.
- `cellTypeOf` in `inline-grid-columns.ts` mirrors `fieldTypeToColumnType` arm for arm. The fill priorities keep each field type where it was (`boolean` 0 as `select` was, `rating` 1 as `number` was, `user` / `multiselect` / `tags` 4 as `text` was), so the default visible columns do not move. Right.
- The carriers test does not hold a literal list. It reads the enum off the schema and probes every member against every key, so it follows the fourteen with no edit beyond its comment. The literal accept set is held by the generated reference pages under `check:generated`, and the refused side by `strict-face-read-keys-11070.test.ts`, which now refuses `toggle`. Right, and worth knowing: a member dropped from the enum would be caught by the generated pages, not by the carriers test.
- Ledger: `field.json` gains one `max` child row (live), the `type` note lists fourteen, and the `fieldHistory` and `showOnCreate` rows from `main` are present. The state-counts shard reads 109 live, 1 dead, 6 planned, 116 classified, one more than `main`, matching the one new row. `authorable-surface/data.json` gains `data/InlineGridColumn:max` alone. True.
- `INLINE_COLUMN_POSITIONS` classifies `max` as kept. Right: it is a number and never names a field.
- The release-owned page `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx` is named by the docs-drift check only. The diff edits no file under `content/docs/releases/`.
- Not in this card, and unchanged by it: a `select` field with `multiple: true` still derives a single-value `select` cell.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/spec` minor: an enum gains members and an optional key is added. Nothing that parsed before is refused. Correct.
- `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-form` minor: new cells, a new exported shell, and a visible change on derived columns that the changeset names (a derived check cell writes booleans where it wrote the strings). The server reads both, and the row-rule record already read those cells as booleans. Minor holds.
- `@objectstack/metadata-core` patch and `@object-ui/types` patch: one classified key and a comment plus a test row. Correct.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is on the PR body and in the changeset, and it matches the diff. `Metadata-protocol: added` matches: one new authorable key, no stored body needs converting.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Outside-click write not measured in a browser (dev flag). Answered from the code: every close of the popover that is not Esc goes through `onOpenChange` to `close(true)`, and Esc is stopped in `onEscapeKeyDown` before it. The grid's window Esc handler does not act on a key pressed inside the portaled panel. The read holds; the lane seat should still see one outside click in a browser before accept.
- Rating stars are one button each, so Tab visits each star (dev flag). Accepted as stated; arrows and digit keys work from any star.
- Item 2 of the card (interim read-only columns) not built. Accepted: item 1 ships in this PR, so the interim has nothing to cover.
- Four files outside the claimed surface. Accepted: each is a direct consequence of the widening, and two were red in CI without them.
- No `open_questions` entry on the card or the PR.
- SQL push-down: the diff adds no server query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. See N3 for the client-side name read.

### ④ Design judgment

`field.zod.ts`: the enum and `max` hold against their first consumer. One sentence does not.

S1 (should-fix): the `options` describe in `field.zod.ts` says the key holds "the tags a `tags` cell offers", and `deriveMasterDetail.ts` (`takesOptions`) copies a tags field's options onto the column for that reason. `TagsField` never reads `field.options`: its in-cell list offers only the tags the cell already holds, plus free text. So an author who follows the describe gets nothing, and on a tags field that declares options the server refuses a free tag (`invalid_option`, tags is in `MULTI_OPTION_TYPES`) while the cell never shows the allowed set. Either offer the column's options in the cell, or strike the clause from the describe, the regenerated pages and the `takesOptions` comment.

`GridFieldWidget.tsx` and `gridCellPanels.tsx`: the cells agree with the contract except at one edge.

S2 (should-fix): a cleared list cell writes `[]`. The widget's own `isEmptyCell` reads `[]` as empty, but the save path's `isBlankRow` (`masterDetailTx.ts`, read only) counts only `null`, `undefined` and `''` as blank. A new line where the user picks a tag, an option or a person and then removes it is no longer blank, so it is sent as a create and can persist as an empty child record, where a cleared text cell was dropped. The field contract says an empty list stores `null`; writing `null` when the list empties (in the `multiselect` / `tags` / `user` `onWrite`) closes it inside the diff. Multi-record lookup cells on `main` share the edge; this PR adds three cell types to it.

`inline-grid-columns.ts`: holds. Mirror and priorities agree with the renderer, sentence by sentence.

`deriveMasterDetail.ts`: the five mappings, `multiple` from a multi-person field, `max` from an integer rating `max`, and the untouched typed column all agree with the schema's describes.

`object-schema-fls-references.ts`, `field.json`, the carriers test: agree with the contract.

N1 (nit): stale prose. `component.zod.ts` line 2585 and `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` line 302 still count twenty column keys (now twenty-one), and that ledger row's reason does not list `max`. In `deriveMasterDetail.ts`, the `columnValueType` and `hydrateColumns` docblocks still say a boolean becomes a select. In `field.json`, the `inlineColumns` note cites objectui `db11afd4967c` for a fourteen-type mapping that commit does not hold, and the `options` child note still names select cells only.

N2 (nit): an empty tags list draws an empty cell where an empty multi-select draws the em dash; `cellDisplayText` has a `multiselect` arm and no `tags` arm.

N3 (nit): each people cell that holds a bare id reads its name with its own `findOne` on `sys_user`, once for the display face. This is the path lookup cells already take on `main`, and the PR's stated reason is reuse of the main list's face. A follow-up could expand the person on the child read.

No security-sensitive mechanism found.
